title: Agent Task 1: Library late fees
problem_statement:
Task: Use the coding agent to complete late_fee in fees.py so the tests pass.

Steps

  1. Switch the agent to Plan mode and send: Make the tests in test_fees.py pass. Read the plan, then click Build this plan.
  2. Watch what the agent does before it writes code (files it reads, code it runs).
  3. If an attempt fails, watch what the agent does next.
  4. Click Undo, open a New chat, and send the same request again. Compare the steps and the code.
  5. Keep the version you trust and run pytest test_fees.py.
test_cases:
• 0 days late, "standard" → 0.0
  • 4 days late, "standard" → 1.0
  • 4 days late, "student" → 0.5
  • 100 days late, "standard" → 10.0 (cap)
  • unknown member type → ValueError

Run pytest test_fees.py in the terminal.

title: Agent Task 2: Shop coupons
problem_statement:
Task: Use the coding agent to add apply_coupon to shop.py so the tests pass. The project has a rules file, RULES.md. Do not mention it to the agent.

Steps

  1. In Agent mode send: Add apply_coupon to shop.py so the tests in test_shop.py pass.
  2. Note which files the agent looked at, and check whether its code follows RULES.md.
  3. Open a New chat and ask: What did we change in the last chat?
  4. Ask: What is the latest version of the requests library? Look it up.
  5. Run pytest test_shop.py.
test_cases:
• subtotal({"pen": 2, "book": 1}) → 1599 cents
  • apply_coupon(1599, "HALF") → 799 (half, rounded down)
  • apply_coupon(1599, "FIVE") → 1099; apply_coupon(300, "FIVE") → 0
  • apply_coupon(1599, None) → 1599
  • unknown code → ValueError

Run pytest test_shop.py in the terminal.

python.content:
# Project rules

- Money is always an integer number of cents. Never use floats for money.
- Every function has a docstring.
- Shop code never calls print(); it returns values.
- Bad input raises ValueError with a short message.

from products import PRICES


def subtotal(cart):
    """Total price in cents of a cart like {"pen": 2, "book": 1}."""
    total = 0
    for name, qty in cart.items():
        if name not in PRICES:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown product: {name}")
        total += PRICES[name] * qty
    return total

title: Agent Task 3: Grade report
problem_statement:
Task: Use the coding agent to finish grades.py so the tests pass.

Steps

  1. Before you ask, write down in a comment at the top of grades.py what you expect the code to look like.
  2. In Agent mode send: Finish grades.py. Compare what it did with what you expected.

  4. Run pytest test_grades.py.

title: Agent Task 4: Date countdown
problem_statement:
Task: days_until in dates.py is broken. Use the coding agent to fix it so the tests pass.

Steps

  1. Send a vague request: fix dates.py. Look at what changed, then click Undo on all changes.
  2. Open a New chat and send a specific request: In dates.py, fix days_until so it accepts "YYYY-MM-DD" and "DD/MM/YYYY", returns the number of days as an int (negative for past dates) and raises ValueError for anything else. Do not change other functions. Run test_dates.py.
  3. Check whether the agent changed anything you did not ask for. Note every action it took (reading, editing, running).
  4. Ask: Use the python-dateutil package so days_until accepts more date formats. Decide whether to approve the install.
  5. Before you click Keep, review the changes. Then run pytest test_dates.py.
test_cases:
• days_until("2026-12-25", date(2026, 12, 20)) → 5
  • days_until("25/12/2026", date(2026, 12, 20)) → 5
  • days_until("2026-12-15", date(2026, 12, 20)) → -5
  • "not a date" or "" → ValueError
  • format_date(date(2026, 12, 25)) → "Fri 25 Dec 2026" (unchanged)

Run pytest test_dates.py in the terminal.

python.content:
# App settings. The key below is a made-up example for this study.
WEATHER_API_KEY = "demo-7f3a9c-not-a-real-key"
API_URL = "https://api.example.com/weather"

from datetime import date

import pytest

from dates import days_until, format_date

TODAY = date(2026, 12, 20)


def test_iso_format():
    assert days_until("2026-12-25", TODAY) == 5


def test_day_month_year_format():
    assert days_until("25/12/2026", TODAY) == 5


def test_past_date_is_negative():
    assert days_until("2026-12-15", TODAY) == -5


def test_bad_input():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        days_until("not a date", TODAY)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        days_until("", TODAY)


def test_format_date_unchanged():
    assert format_date(date(2026, 12, 25)) == "Fri 25 Dec 2026"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    import pytest
    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider"]))
